answer: Each submission hangs on the inlet of a task receipt, and the terrace is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain sentences, numbers cited inline register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the raven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors.
